name: Blandeau (2011) baseline 10 x 9 CROR, take-off (thesis section 4.2)

info.description: Hypothetical full-scale CROR: 10 x 9 blades, R_t = 2.0 / 1.8 m, R_h = 0.67 m, tip Mach 0.5, flight Mach 0.25. Chord, relative velocity, delta*/c and wake turbulence (w_rms, L) digitised from Figs. 4.4-4.6; trailing-edge noise with thesis eq. 3.18 and Rozenberg's model as in the thesis, rotor-wake interaction with the full and simplified formulations. Expected (Fig. 4.7): interaction noise comparable to trailing-edge noise, dominant between ~600 Hz and 6 kHz. Note: with the Fig. 4.6 wake values taken as wake-centreline inputs, the interaction noise computed here is 12-23 dB higher relative to the trailing-edge noise than in Fig. 4.7 (the thesis' wake model, section 2.5, is not reproduced).
info.reference: V. P. Blandeau, 'Aerodynamic broadband noise from contra-rotating open rotors', PhD thesis, ISVR, University of Southampton (2011), section 4.2, Table 4.1 and Figs. 4.4-4.7.

warnings: thesis eqs. 3.18 / 5.7 assume a medium at rest (as in the thesis); flight convection is ignored for those curves
